observations.observation: Five numbered columns: Sense, Process, Perceive, Decide, Act. Sensors precede processing, object detection/maps, path/action decisions and commands; CV, point clouds and fusion listed.
Deterministic state-to-action mapping and stochastic conditional probabilities; Sarsa on-policy and Q-learning off-policy comparison boxes.
Model-free TD description and fully annotated Q update; current estimate, learning rate and TD bracket; decay and convergence prose has no complete assumption list.

Q initialized arbitrarily outside episodes; select action, observe reward/next state, update then advance state until terminal. No explicit terminal-row zeroing or terminal mask appears. Epsilon box has 0<epsilon<1 and exploit/explore branch probabilities.

Source Python updates Q using max of the next row, then advances state and adds reward, then breaks on terminated or truncated. No terminal mask is printed; true-terminal masking in Q056 is an explicit adaptation.

Seven image-processing summary bullets: arrays, histograms, point ops, neighborhoods, correlation/convolution, smoothing/median, Sobel. All have prior reviewed concepts, with pointwise-map estimation qualification retained.

Summary repeats ANN/CNN motivation, feature maps, classification/detection, one/two-stage detectors, YOLO regression and version evolution. ANN fail and each-version-improved wording remain qualified by reviewed questions.

Four DRL summary bullets: neural approximation, main/target networks, epsilon/Boltzmann choices, inflated-reward DQN navigation case. All linked semantically to reviewed concepts, without universal success/safety claims.

boundary: New actual-page observations support semantic bookkeeping. They do not re-approve the unchanged linked questions or substitute for their independent review records.
